note: 15.5 x 18 cm black iron diamond-cage pendant on a natural wood socket cover, 10 cm round ceiling cap, 100 cm cord. The first METAL fixture in the catalogue, admitted 2026-09-13 after Daniel widened the brief past the bamboo/rattan niche ('we dont need to just stay in the lamp niche'). Sourced from listing 1005007802917011 (ZEGEL Store; 4.7 from 22 reviews, 167 sold), SKU 200000531:173#B Style;136:200003939#no bulb - the B style is the cord-hung black single; A/C are flush mounts, D is the white single, E-H are photographs of A-D, I-L are three-head clusters at C$88.03 list. Rule 18: nothing else in the catalogue is a wire cage, a metal shade or a diamond silhouette. Benchmarked against its OWN amazon.ca 8-keyword cage/industrial pendant basket (run 27, read twice), not the bamboo pendant band: the class is different and its band sits lower (C$64.49 against C$75.42).

scripts/check-contribution-derivation.mjs deriveContributions() at ourRetailCad 69.99, itemCostCad 36.36, supplierShipCad 0, dutyRate 0.07 -> wholesale 18.65.
costSource: AliExpress Canadian-gateway per-SKU price from window._d_c_ PRICE.skuPriceInfoMap on listing 1005007802917011, SKU 200000531:173#B Style;136:200003939#no bulb, read 2026-09-13: salePriceString C$26.18 against originalPrice C$36.36, with the page's sale banner reading 'Ends: Sep 20'. That is a 28% gap - a promotion, not rounding - so RULE 22 makes the LIST price the cost basis and itemCostCad is 36.36, NOT 26.18. Every single-head style on the listing (A-H) carries the same pair; the three-head styles (I-L) read C$63.38 against C$88.03. Not yet cross-checked against a DSers stable cost: the product does not exist in Shopify or DSers yet, and the DSers reading is the mapping step, not the sourcing step.
dutyRateBasis: Canada HS 9405.11.00 (electric lighting fittings designed for LED) / 9405.19.00 (other), MFN column, 7%. Canada applies no Section 301 equivalent to these goods - its surtaxes on Chinese imports cover electric vehicles, steel and aluminium - so MFN is the entire stack. The 7% is charged on VALUE FOR DUTY, which is the supplier price.
verdict: Priced at CA$69.99, CA$5.50 over the CA$64.49 amazon.ca cage/industrial pendant band median and CA$4.17 under the CA$74.16 RULE 2 ceiling. Contributes CA$18.65/unit on the wholesale basis (7% MFN on value for duty) at the LIST cost of C$36.36 with free freight, against the CA$16.23 floor - clears by CA$2.42. This class's band is lower than the bamboo pendants' (median 64.49 against 75.42, ceiling 74.16 against 86.73), so the shared CA$74.99 is OVER this ceiling and cannot be used; CA$64.99 files 14.32, under the floor; CA$69.99 is the only x.99 that clears both the floor and the ceiling. Rule 22: the page sells at C$26.18 under a timed banner, a 28% gap under the C$36.36 originalPrice, so the list price is the cost basis. Per-SKU stock 182 clears rule 4 (>= 25). Voltage 90-260 V, E27, no bulb. Rule 18: the only wire cage, metal shade and diamond silhouette in the catalogue. Thin: a C$2.42 cushion means a freight charge of more than about C$2.25 or a list-price rise of more than about C$2.25 takes it under the floor - re-read cost and shipping before any paid push.

B Style is the cord-hung black single-head cage with the wood socket cover and 10 cm cap; the underlying propertyValueName the gateway carries for it is 'Blue', a leftover of the seller's colour template, and means nothing.
